title: The MJ-12 documents
reason: Every member names the papers leaked from 1984 into the 1990s as the Majestic 12 or MJ-12 documents (Jesse Michels: "a string of documents '84 into the '90s"; the Gordon Gray, Menzel, Bronk and Forrestal tellings credit them under each spelling); a document titled Majestic 12 or MJ-12 can only be these papers. Majestic (Strieber's novel), the Woods' Majestic Documents collection and the single MJ-12 document are left out.

title: Eisenhower briefing document (MJ-12, 1952)
reason: One MJ-12 paper: the briefing supposedly prepared in November 1952 for president-elect Eisenhower; the majestic-12-briefing-document story credits it under both ids and Greg Bishop's account of the MJ12 papers calls it the Eisenhower briefing memo.

title: Glowing Auras and 'Black Money': The Pentagon's Mysterious U.F.O. Program (The New York Times, 16 December 2017)
reason: Every member is the December 2017 New York Times article by Helene Cooper, Ralph Blumenthal and Leslie Kean on AATIP and the Navy videos (the tellings name Kean, Blumenthal, December 2017 and the videos released with it). The generic New York Times ids, which also credit the 2019 cubes-and-spheres article, are left out.

title: Project Blue Book records
reason: As a document Project Blue Book is the Air Force's case files of 1952 to 1969; the members are those files under other names (Sheehan's account credits the Blue Book files and the classified Blue Book files alike). The Blue Book briefing books (remote viewing) and Special Report 14 are other documents and are left out.

title: FBI file on Thomas Townsend Brown (1942 to 1943)
reason: One FBI file on Townsend Brown from 1942 to 1943, recently surfaced by Paul Schatzkin; the tellings quote it for his Laurel Canyon address and for his being the Navy's leading radar man, and Jesse Michels dates it "1942 or three".

title: Allen Dulles's diary (released with the JFK files, 2022)
reason: Allen Dulles's appointment diary released with the 2022 JFK files, cited against the dates in the MJ-12 papers; "Duell's diary" is the captions' spelling of Dulles's diary in the same story ("doulest diary entries").

title: Immaculate Constellation capabilities briefing
reason: Both are the briefing Matthew Brown says he found on a shared Intelink server in 2018 ("encountered this immaculate constellation document within the government"). Shellenberger's 2024 report is a different document and is left out.

title: Sekret Machines (Tom DeLonge's book series)

title: Atomic Energy Act of 1954

title: Atomic Energy Act of 1946 (McMahon Act)
reason: One statute, the McMahon Act, which is the Atomic Energy Act of 1946; the Condon stories credit it under each name ("the McMahon secrecy Act of 1946, which is the precursor to the atomic energy Act of 1954").
